name: Noise
description: Adds gaussian or uniform noise, static or changing every frame.

params.name: strength
params.description: Noise strength in 8-bit levels (`alls`); FFmpeg's default is 0 (no noise)

params.name: temporal
params.description: 1 = the noise changes every frame (flag `t`), 0 = the same noise on every frame

params.name: mono
params.description: 1 = the same noise on R, G and B (gray grain), 0 = independent per channel
